docs.purpose: The one web SEARCH binding: SearchBinding.tsx maps a SEARCH situation to a props tree (refs only; the same blocks, refs and actions as the mobile binding) and renders it with the mapped Mantine parts (bindings.json mapping.web.SEARCH). It holds no display text of its own.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing itself: the mount file passes the situation, the content strings and the bound data.
docs.under_126: **PROMOTED BINDING ENTRY** (P42-D9 a; Spec 126 §11b.5, the first web consumer of SEARCH; MF-44 plan v2 §1 P1-P3): a platform_shared census entry that owns the binding module, so R-13 totality holds while the converted surfaces own no component.

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.
spec_refs: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §11b.3 dated note 2026-11-11 — MF-44, the web target of mobile_parcel_search through the one web SEARCH binding

versioning.why: A binding module has no wire contract of its own: its input is a props tree whose shape is pinned by the consuming surface's goldens (mobile_parcel_search, src/tests/fixtures/surfaces/mobile_parcel_search/*.web.json) and its output is library parts. A change shows up as a golden, parity or render-smoke failure of the consumer.
evidence: src/tests/surfaces/admin-media.golden.test.ts — T7: the consumer web goldens equal a fresh build from searchWebTree
src/tests/surfaces/search-web-binding.ui.test.tsx — the web render smoke of every golden

inputs.why: Descriptor, content and data arrive as props from the mount file.

outputs.why: A binding writes nothing; a form submit is handed back to the mount file.

state.why: No store: the library component holds its own local UI state.

staleness.why: It renders what it is given.

session.why: Its only consumer today is the MaxBLD web search page; each consumer declares its own guard.
evidence: src/app/(maxbld)/parcel-tool/page.tsx — the mount file; require-parcel-tool-page.ts first

rls_class.why: It renders lookup data the consumer reads through GET /api/parcels/lookup (parcels and address points, Class B) once the live switch is on; it reads no table itself.
evidence: src/app/api/parcels/lookup/route.ts — the route the consumer calls

checks.why: The module is listed in bindings.json modules and owned by this entry (FE-31 C-3); a module nobody owns is a hand-built component.

errors.why: Errors belong to the consuming surface; the binding throws on a missing content key or an unknown widget so a gap is loud.

metering.why: Rendering is not a metered product action.

config.why: No tunable of its own. The SEARCH profile requires debounce_ms and min_query_len, which have no "none" value: 0 states that the binding itself neither debounces nor gates on length. The consuming surface declares its own (mobile_parcel_search: 400 ms, 3 characters), applied by the mount when the live switch is on.
evidence: src/components/surfaces/web/SearchBinding.tsx — no debounce or length gate of its own

sharing.why: Every converted web SEARCH surface (the parcel search page first).
sharing.varies_by_surface: Only the props tree, content and data passed in.

notes: MF-44 (operator "01-a 0-2 b as long as they are complaint"; Spec 126 §11b.5). Archetype SEARCH: the entry carries the archetype of the module it owns (MF-35 OUTPUT fold MEDIUM 3); the SEARCH-gated fields describe the consuming surface, not this binding, and are answered none with a why.

programme.why: Shared rendering infrastructure: the binding every converted web SEARCH surface renders through.
